items.title: Do Quebec police recruits get enough racial profiling training? We checked the curriculum
items.summary_auto: At Quebec's provincial police academy, aspiring officers spend hundreds of hours on technical skills crucial to the job, from firing weapons to physically restraining suspects. items.title: Canada presented itself as a global leader in methane reductions at COP31. But is Alberta holding it back?

items.title: Community comes together to say farewell to Bailey, a dog with cancer

items.title: Gatineau Park's leaves contained Cold War-era nuclear radiation as late as 2024, study says
items.summary_auto: For 65 years, scientists have been collecting maple leaves from Gatineau Park to look for signs of nuclear radiation. According to a new study published in the journal Nature Scientific Reports, as late as 2024, those leaves still had traces of radiocarbon dating to the early years of the Cold War.

items.title: Canada-wide flight grounding unlikely, says aviation expert
